annotations.title: New builds on sale in a place (Spain)

description: New-build developments on sale in a municipality, buyer zone or province of the flatin.es catalogue: at most 25 per call, sorted by name, no pagination — the full list is on the linked flatin.es page. Facts are the developer's own, latest check only, with attribution.

delivery_by.description: Completion by the end of this year (this year to this year + 4); ready-to-move-in developments always match.

locale.description: Language of names and page links; default en.

max_beach_km.description: Straight-line km from the development's own location to the nearest beach, rounded up to 1, 2, 5 or 10; only when the site offers the beach filter.

max_price.description: Budget in euros, VAT included: the price from must not exceed it. search_url uses the site's budget bucket rounded up (named in the answer). Developments without a published price are left out.

place.description: Municipality (name, slug, 'province/municipality' or 5-digit INE code), buyer zone (costa-blanca, costa-del-sol) or province; prefix 'provincia:' / 'zona:' to disambiguate.
